chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Salim reported to me, he said: Ali ibn Ismail Abu al-Hasan al-Atrush narrated to me, he said: Muhammad ibn Khalaf al-Muqri narrated to us, he said: Husayn al-Ashqar narrated to us, he said: Qays ibn al-Rabi narrated to us, from his father, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them both), who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: "O Anas! Call for me the master of the Arabs." He said: "O Messenger of God, are you not the master of the Arabs?" He said: "I am the master of the children of Adam, and Ali is the master of the Arabs." So he called Ali, and when Ali (peace be upon him) came, he said: "O Anas, call for me the Ansar." When they came, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: "O people of the Ansar, this is Ali, the master of the Arabs. Love him for the sake of my love, and honour him for the sake of my honour, for indeed Jibrail (peace be upon him) has informed me from God, Mighty and Majestic, of what I tell you."

key_terms.الأنصار: The Ansar (helpers) - the people of Medina who supported the Prophet after his migration from Mecca
key_terms.سيد العرب: Master of the Arabs - a title given exclusively to Ali ibn Abi Talib by the Prophet
key_terms.سيد ولد آدم: Master of the children of Adam - the Prophet's self-description of his universal leadership over all humanity

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali being the master of the Arabs?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) summoned Ali (AS) and presented him before the Ansar as the "master of the Arabs," distinguishing his own status as "master of the children of Adam" from Ali's status as master of the Arabs. This narration was delivered in Medina to the Ansar specifically, establishing a religious obligation to love and honour Ali, with the Prophet emphasizing that this declaration was divinely revealed through the angel Jibrail.
